text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu had spent a fulfilling summer training camp.
She thoroughly polished her running,
and on top of that—found something to look forward to in the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It was such a wonderful time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I understand quite well just how deep
and rich the color of your passion is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I will make the most beautiful autumn flowers bloom...
I have stored up plenty of nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer until it blooms...
I can hardly wait.

Finally, the final crown of the Triple Tiara,
the Shuka Sho, is drawing near...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So cliché...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text: —Lady Mejiro Ramonu. Your car is ready.

Normally, the academy arranges transportation for the summer training camp.
However, some girls make their own way to camp.
She happened to be one of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No, I'll take the bus.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: By your side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Please, go on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do our best"... Huh.
That's far too simplistic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Both the Oka Sho and the Yushun Himba... Were those the words used?

It seems she remembered the pre-race advice I've given her so far.
And now, she's asking for it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Now, go right ahead.
choice_data_list: It looks like the first half of the Shuka Sho will be a slow pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: The other girls have grown quite a lot over this summer too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I suppose so.
choice_data_list: We can't really put much stock in the data, huh.
I don't think we can put too much stock in the data, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

For a while after boarding the bus, I was talking
to Mejiro Ramonu about key points for the Shuka Sho.
As I grew increasingly passionate—

text_block_list.name: Bus Driver
text_block_list.text:
“—The bus will be departing shortly.
Please take your seats.”
choice_data_list: In the end... believe in yourself and run it out!

text_block_list.text:
What slipped out in the end were the words that had utterly shot me down when I said them to Mejiro Ramonu during the Oka Sho...
In a panic, I tried to take them back—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Your true nature is quite simple, isn't it?

And so, our second summer training camp
came to an end...
